verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh has a documented public REST API. It covers API credentials with configurable permissions, endpoints for customers, screening, cases, exports, audit trails and transactions, and documented rate limiting and versioning. A Postman collection is offered, and a probe retrieved and parsed a public OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema; the 404s on generic OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, since the schema lives at a different path. Missing for 10: hands-on corroboration of authenticated API calls, and independent user reports of driving the product end-to-end via the API.
